name: chain1
author: ghjob360
tagline: an eight-voice synth in a fixed chain: OSC, FILTER, EG, MOD, DELAY, REVERB, ARP; runs NTS-1 logue SDK units
description: Up to eight voices (poly, mono, legato, unison) through a fixed chain - five oscillators, a 2/4-pole filter with its own ADSR envelope and key tracking, an ADSR amp envelope with velocity, a six-wave LFO, chorus/ensemble/phaser/flanger/tremolo, five delays, five reverbs and an arpeggiator with gate and swing; 16 memories. The OSC, MOD, DELAY and REVERB places also run logue SDK units built for the NTS-1 (mk1 .ntkdigunit, mkII .nts1mkiiunit): their own ARM code, interpreted on the second core. Its layout follows a well-known pocket synth's signal flow; the DSP is original.
